qa_pairs.question: What should you check before driving a car onto a lifting platform?
qa_pairs.answer: Before driving a car on the platform, make sure that there is sufficient space (clearance) between the lifting platform and vehicle (if applicable spoiler, splash guard etc.).

qa_pairs.question: What type of regulations must lifting platforms conform with?
qa_pairs.answer: Lifting platforms must conform with local and national legislative measures concerning accident prevention and maintenance.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the arms of a lifting platform always be applied?
qa_pairs.answer: Arms of a lifting platform must always be applied only on the reinforced points of the frame members.

qa_pairs.question: What should be used between the lifting arm and vehicle frame at the front?
qa_pairs.answer: Apply rubber block of lifting arm on the front perpendicular reinforcement of the frame member, which is also provided for application of the car's jack.

qa_pairs.question: What is important to avoid when placing the rear lifting arm?
qa_pairs.answer: Do not touch on fuel tank underside.

qa_pairs.question: What materials can be used as a suitable liner when using a workshop trolley jack?
qa_pairs.answer: A suitable liner (rubber, wood or plastic) must be used between the jack and vehicle to avoid damage to the undercoating, frame members or floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What happens to halfshaft joints if you drive the car while lifted?
qa_pairs.answer: Driving the car while lifted, will destroy the halfshaft joints because of excessive bending angle.

qa_pairs.question: Where can a workshop trolley jack be applied for lifting?
qa_pairs.answer: A workshop trolley jack may also be only applied for lifting the vehicle on the same take-up points described for the lifting platform.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two main take-up points shown for lifting the vehicle?
qa_pairs.answer: The two main take-up points are the Front Take-up Point and Rear Take-up Point.

qa_pairs.question: What caution is given regarding driving a lifted car?
qa_pairs.answer: Driving the car while lifted, will destroy the halfshaft joints because of excessive bending angle.

qa_pairs.question: What type of block should be used with the lifting arm on frame reinforcements?
qa_pairs.answer: Apply rubber block of lifting arm on the perpendicular reinforcement of the frame member.
